topic: What if you opened a McDonald's in ancient Rome?

script.text: The smoke hits the street first. Then the smell. Sizzling meat, toasted bread, melted cheese.
A line of people stretches all the way around the block. Senators in white togas. Soldiers. Bakers still covered in flour.
A gladiator the size of a door orders twelve. He eats three before he reaches the corner.
A little boy takes his first bite, and his eyes go huge. A senator pays with a silver coin, and doesn't even wait for his change.
Above the counter, a painted sign says Burgus Maximus. You painted it yourself.
Because this is Rome. The year sixty-four. Nobody here has ever eaten a burger. And you just opened the first burger restaurant on Earth.
What if you opened a McDonald's in ancient Rome?
Sounds like you'd be rich by Friday. But in Rome, being loved by the crowd is the most dangerous thing there is. And in eight days, this whole city is going to burn.
